# Moulded Text

Stroke width of moulded lettering; also warns of text recessed into the part.

<figure markdown="span">
![Moulded Text: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-text-stroke-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Moulded Text: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-text-stroke-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Stroke width of moulded lettering; raised text lasts better than text cut into the part.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | Low |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 0.5 mm | 0.25 mm | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PA, PC, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Thin Text Strokes (`{measured}`): `{feature}` has `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Fine strokes are hard to cut into the steel and fill poorly. Use a bolder, plain (sans-serif) font.
!!! failure "Error"

    Text Strokes Too Thin (`{measured}`): `{feature}` has `{size}`, under `{limit}`. Strokes this fine won't cut cleanly into the mould or fill, and the letters come out broken. Use a bold sans-serif font with strokes of at least `{target}`.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
